item.title: FTSE 100 ticks higher as Middle East tensions persist
item.summary: The FTSE 100 ticked higher on Monday against a backdrop of heightened geopolitical risks, as metal prices rose, helping London’s diversified miners advance. It was a different story for US futures, which were pointing to a slightly lower open, reflecting broader concerns about developments in the Middle East and the risk to inflation.
